message: You know those moments when you realize you’ve left the house without your pants? Well, being unprepared for a storm feels a bit like that. I stumbled upon a handy resource about winter weather preparedness that’s a good reminder to have a plan in place before the snow starts flying. After all, it’s much easier to sip cocoa by the fire than scramble for flashlights in the dark! Have you ever been caught off guard by a storm? ☕️
